title: Track action items in their own skill
analysis: Action items from standups need follow-up after the digest is written. A dedicated skill can track them, and StandupDigest hands them over instead of only listing them.

title: Group action items by owner
analysis: People look for their own tasks first. Grouping the standup action items by owner saves them from scanning the whole list.

title: Rename to TeamDigest
analysis: The skill now handles weekly syncs and Slack threads, not only standups. Its name and the description members read should say so.

title: Keep it for members only
analysis: Agents pick the skill up for messages that are not standup updates. Making it available to members only stops that without hiding it from people.
